stage_label: Stress building (0+): no red signals in A-E; yellows persist in B and C
read: The framework's lone red signal since Sep 14 has cleared: the SOX closed Sep 18 at 11,921.69, only 18.5% below its June high (versus 20.7-23.9% on every prior run), and the 20-trading-day rotation flipped back in AI leaders' favor (SOX, NVDA and AMD outpacing the equal-weight S&P by 8-9 points) -- so Pillar A now holds zero reds and A4 moves from yellow to green. Nothing in capex, revenue or credit improved or worsened to match: Oracle CDS, CoreWeave and the AI-debt-deal signal are unchanged, and SoftBank formally launched the $10B+/EUR1B bond it needs to fund its Oct 1 OpenAI payment, with pricing due Sep 24 -- the most consequential near-term credit test still pending. Net effect is a genuine, if narrow, move away from 'popping': Stage drops from Stage 1 (price break) to Stage 0+ (stress building), since no pillar shows a red and the yellows are concentrated in financing (B2, C1, C4, C5) rather than in a confirmed capex or credit failure.
